passages.label: Mart. 9.pr.1
passages.text: Have, mi Torani, frater carissime. Epigramma, quod

passages.label: Mart. 9.pr.2
passages.text: extra ordinem paginarum est, ad Stertinium clarissimum

passages.label: Mart. 9.pr.3
passages.text: virum scripsimus, qui imaginem meam ponere in biblio-

passages.label: Mart. 9.pr.4
passages.text: theca sua voluit. De quo scribendum tibi putavi, ne

passages.label: Mart. 9.pr.5
passages.text: ignorares, Avitus iste quis vocaretur. Vale et para ho-

passages.label: Mart. 9.pr.6
passages.text: spitium.

passages.label: Mart. 9.pr.7
passages.text: Note, licet nolis, sublimi pectore vates,

passages.label: Mart. 9.pr.8
passages.text: Cui referet serus praemia digna cinis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.pr.9
passages.text: Hoc tibi sub nostra breve carmen imagine vivat,

passages.label: Mart. 9.pr.10
passages.text: Quam non obscuris iungis, Avite, viris:

passages.label: Mart. 9.pr.11
passages.text: 'Ille ego sum nulli nugarum laude secundus,

passages.label: Mart. 9.pr.12
passages.text: Quem non miraris, sed puto, lector, amas.

passages.label: Mart. 9.pr.13
passages.text: Maiores maiora sonent: mihi parva locuto

passages.label: Mart. 9.pr.14
passages.text: Sufficit in vestras saepe redire manus.'

passages.label: Mart. 9.1.1
passages.text: Dum Ianus hiemes, Domitianus autumnos,

passages.label: Mart. 9.1.2
passages.text: Augustus annis commodabit aestates,

passages.label: Mart. 9.1.3
passages.text: Dum grande famuli nomen adseret Rheni

passages.label: Mart. 9.1.4
passages.text: Germanicarum magna lux Kalendarum,

passages.label: Mart. 9.1.5
passages.text: Tarpeia summi saxa dum patris stabunt,

passages.label: Mart. 9.1.6
passages.text: Dum voce supplex dumque ture placabit

passages.label: Mart. 9.1.7
passages.text: Matrona divae dulce Iuliae numen:

passages.label: Mart. 9.1.8
passages.text: Manebit altum Flaviae decus gentis

passages.label: Mart. 9.1.9
passages.text: Cum sole et astris cumque luce Romana.

passages.label: Mart. 9.1.10
passages.text: Invicta quidquid condidit manus, caeli est.

passages.label: Mart. 9.2.1
passages.text: Pauper amicitiae cum sis, Lupe, non es amicae,

passages.label: Mart. 9.2.2
passages.text: Et queritur de te mentula sola nihil.

passages.label: Mart. 9.2.3
passages.text: Illa siligineis pinguescit adultera cunnis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.2.4
passages.text: Convivam pascit nigra farina tuum;

passages.label: Mart. 9.2.5
passages.text: Incensura nives dominae Setina liquantur,

passages.label: Mart. 9.2.6
passages.text: Nos bibimus Corsi pulla venena cadi;

passages.label: Mart. 9.2.7
passages.text: Empta tibi nox est fundis non tota paternis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.2.8
passages.text: Non sua desertus rura sodalis arat;

passages.label: Mart. 9.2.9
passages.text: Splendet Erythraeis perlucida moecha lapillis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.2.10
passages.text: Ducitur addictus, te futuente, cliens;

passages.label: Mart. 9.2.11
passages.text: Octo Syris suffulta datur lectica puellae,

passages.label: Mart. 9.2.12
passages.text: Nudum sandapilae pondus amicus erit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.2.13
passages.text: I nunc et miseros, Cybele, praecide cinaedos:

passages.label: Mart. 9.2.14
passages.text: Haec erat, haec cultris mentula digna tuis.

passages.label: Mart. 9.3.1
passages.text: Quantum iam superis, Caesar, caeloque dedisti

passages.label: Mart. 9.3.2
passages.text: Si repetas et si creditor esse velis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.3.3
passages.text: Grandis in aetherio licet auctio fiat Olympo

passages.label: Mart. 9.3.4
passages.text: Coganturque dei vendere quidquid habent,

passages.label: Mart. 9.3.5
passages.text: Conturbabit Atlans, et non erit uncia tota,

passages.label: Mart. 9.3.6
passages.text: Decidat tecum qua pater ipse deu=m:

passages.label: Mart. 9.3.7
passages.text: Pro Capitolinis quid enim tibi solvere templis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.3.8
passages.text: Quid pro Tarpeiae frondis honore potest?

passages.label: Mart. 9.3.9
passages.text: Quid pro culminibus geminis matrona Tonantis?

passages.label: Mart. 9.3.10
passages.text: Pallada praetereo: res agit illa tuas.

passages.label: Mart. 9.3.11
passages.text: Quid loquar Alciden Phoebumque piosque Laconas?

passages.label: Mart. 9.3.12
passages.text: Addita quid Latio Flavia templa polo?

passages.label: Mart. 9.3.13
passages.text: Expectes et sustineas, Auguste, necesse est:

passages.label: Mart. 9.3.14
passages.text: Nam tibi quod solvat non habet arca Iovis.

passages.label: Mart. 9.4.1
passages.text: Aureolis futui cum possit Galla duobus

passages.label: Mart. 9.4.2
passages.text: Et plus quam futui, si totidem addideris:

passages.label: Mart. 9.4.3
passages.text: Aureolos a te cur accipit, Aeschyle, denos?

passages.label: Mart. 9.4.4
passages.text: Non fellat tanti Galla. Quid ergo? Tacet.

passages.label: Mart. 9.5.1
passages.text: Tibi, summe Rheni domitor et parens orbis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.5.2
passages.text: Pudice princeps, gratias agunt urbes:

passages.label: Mart. 9.5.3
passages.text: Populos habebunt; parere iam scelus non est.

passages.label: Mart. 9.5.4
passages.text: Non puer avari sectus arte mangonis

passages.label: Mart. 9.5.5
passages.text: Virilitatis damna maeret ereptae,

passages.label: Mart. 9.5.6
passages.text: Nec quam superbus conputet stipem leno,

passages.label: Mart. 9.5.7
passages.text: Dat prostituto misera mater infanti.

passages.label: Mart. 9.5.8
passages.text: Qui nec cubili fuerat ante te quondam,

passages.label: Mart. 9.5.9
passages.text: Pudor esse per te coepit et lupanari.

passages.label: Mart. 9.6.1
passages.text: Dicere de Libycis reduci tibi gentibus, Afer,

passages.label: Mart. 9.6.2
passages.text: Continuis volui quinque diebus Have:

passages.label: Mart. 9.6.3
passages.text: 'Non vacat' aut 'dormit' dictum est bis terque reverso.

passages.label: Mart. 9.6.4
passages.text: Iam satis est: non vis, Afer, havere: vale.

passages.label: Mart. 9.7.1
passages.text: Tamquam parva foret sexus iniuria nostri

passages.label: Mart. 9.7.2
passages.text: Foedandos populo prostituisse mares,

passages.label: Mart. 9.7.3
passages.text: Iam cunae lenonis erant, ut ab ubere raptus

passages.label: Mart. 9.7.4
passages.text: Sordida vagitu posceret aera puer:

passages.label: Mart. 9.7.5
passages.text: Inmatura dabant infandas corpora poenas.

passages.label: Mart. 9.7.6
passages.text: Non tulit Ausonius talia monstra pater,

passages.label: Mart. 9.7.7
passages.text: Idem qui teneris nuper succurrit ephebis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.7.8
passages.text: Ne faceret steriles saeva libido viros.

passages.label: Mart. 9.7.9
passages.text: Dilexere prius pueri iuvenesque senesque,

passages.label: Mart. 9.7.10
passages.text: At nunc infantes te quoque, Caesar, amant.

passages.label: Mart. 9.8.1
passages.text: Nil tibi legavit Fabius, Bithynice, cui tu

passages.label: Mart. 9.8.2
passages.text: Annua, si memini, milia sena dabas.

passages.label: Mart. 9.8.3
passages.text: Plus nulli dedit ille: queri, Bithynice, noli:

passages.label: Mart. 9.8.4
passages.text: Annua legavit milia sena tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 9.9.1
passages.text: Cenes, Canthare, cum foris libenter,

passages.label: Mart. 9.9.2
passages.text: Clamas et maledicis et minaris.

passages.label: Mart. 9.9.3
passages.text: Deponas animos truces, monemus:

passages.label: Mart. 9.9.4
passages.text: Liber non potes et gulosus esse.

passages.label: Mart. 9.10.1
passages.text: Nubere vis Prisco: non miror, Paula: sapisti.

passages.label: Mart. 9.10.2
passages.text: Ducere te non vult Priscus: et ille sapit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.1
passages.text: Nomen cum violis rosisque natum,

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.2
passages.text: Quo pars optima nominatur anni,

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.3
passages.text: Hyblam quod sapit Atticosque flores,

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.4
passages.text: Quod nidos olet alitis superbae;

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.5
passages.text: Nomen nectare dulcius beato,

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.6
passages.text: Quo mallet Cybeles puer vocari

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.7
passages.text: Et qui pocula temperat Tonanti,

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.8
passages.text: Quod si Parrhasia sones in aula,

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.9
passages.text: Respondent Veneres Cupidinesque;

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.10
passages.text: Nomen nobile, molle, delicatum

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.11
passages.text: Versu dicere non rudi volebam:

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.12
passages.text: Sed tu syllaba contumax rebellas.

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.13
passages.text: Dicunt Eiarinon tamen poetae,

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.14
passages.text: Sed Graeci, quibus est nihil negatum

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.15
passages.text: Et quos Ἆρεσ Ἄρεσ decet sonare:

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.16
passages.text: Nobis non licet esse tam disertis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.11.17
passages.text: Qui Musas colimus severiores.

passages.label: Mart. 9.12.1
passages.text: Nomen habes teneri quod tempora nuncupat anni,

passages.label: Mart. 9.12.2
passages.text: Cum breve Cecropiae ver populantur apes;

passages.label: Mart. 9.12.3
passages.text: Nomen Acidalia meruit quod harundine pingi,

passages.label: Mart. 9.12.4
passages.text: Quod Cytherea sua scribere gaudet acu;

passages.label: Mart. 9.12.5
passages.text: Nomen Erythraeis quod littera facta lapillis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.12.6
passages.text: Gemma quod Heliadum pollice trita notet;

passages.label: Mart. 9.12.7
passages.text: Quod pinna scribente grues ad sidera tollant;

passages.label: Mart. 9.12.8
passages.text: Quod decet in sola Caesaris esse domo.

passages.label: Mart. 9.13.1
passages.text: Si daret autumnus mihi nomen, Oporinos essem,

passages.label: Mart. 9.13.2
passages.text: Horrida si brumae sidera, Chimerinos;

passages.label: Mart. 9.13.3
passages.text: Dictus ab aestivo Therinos tibi mense vocarer:

passages.label: Mart. 9.13.4
passages.text: Tempora cui nomen verna dedere, quis est?

passages.label: Mart. 9.14.1
passages.text: Hunc, quem mensa tibi, quem cena paravit amicum,

passages.label: Mart. 9.14.2
passages.text: Esse putas fidae pectus amicitiae?

passages.label: Mart. 9.14.3
passages.text: Aprum amat et mullos et sumen et ostrea, non te.

passages.label: Mart. 9.14.4
passages.text: Tam bene si cenem, noster amicus erit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.15.1
passages.text: Inscripsit tumulis septem scelerata virorum

passages.label: Mart. 9.15.2
passages.text: 'Se fecisse' Chloe. Quid pote simplicius?

passages.label: Mart. 9.16.1
passages.text: Consilium formae, speculum, dulcisque capillos

passages.label: Mart. 9.16.2
passages.text: Pergameo posuit dona sacrata deo

passages.label: Mart. 9.16.3
passages.text: Ille puer tota domino gratissimus aula,

passages.label: Mart. 9.16.4
passages.text: Nomine qui signat tempora verna suo.

passages.label: Mart. 9.16.5
passages.text: Felix, quae tali censetur munere tellus!

passages.label: Mart. 9.16.6
passages.text: Nec Ganymedeas mallet habere comas.

passages.label: Mart. 9.17.1
passages.text: Latonae venerande nepos, qui mitibus herbis

passages.label: Mart. 9.17.2
passages.text: Parcarum exoras pensa brevesque colos,

passages.label: Mart. 9.17.3
passages.text: Hos tibi laudatos domino, rata vota, capillos

passages.label: Mart. 9.17.4
passages.text: Ille tuus Latia misit ab urbe puer;

passages.label: Mart. 9.17.5
passages.text: Addidit et nitidum sacratis crinibus orbem,

passages.label: Mart. 9.17.6
passages.text: Quo felix facies iudice tuta fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.17.7
passages.text: Tu iuvenale decus serva, ne pulchrior ille

passages.label: Mart. 9.17.8
passages.text: In longa fuerit quam breviore coma.

passages.label: Mart. 9.18.1
passages.text: Est mihi—sitque precor longum te praeside, Caesar—

passages.label: Mart. 9.18.2
passages.text: Rus minimum, parvi sunt et in urbe lares.

passages.label: Mart. 9.18.3
passages.text: Sed de valle brevi, quas det sitientibus hortis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.18.4
passages.text: Curva laboratas antlia tollit aquas:

passages.label: Mart. 9.18.5
passages.text: Sicca domus queritur nullo se rore foveri,

passages.label: Mart. 9.18.6
passages.text: Cum mihi vicino Marcia fonte sonet.

passages.label: Mart. 9.18.7
passages.text: Quam dederis nostris, Auguste, penatibus undam,

passages.label: Mart. 9.18.8
passages.text: Castalis haec nobis aut Iovis imber erit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.19.1
passages.text: Laudas balnea versibus trecentis

passages.label: Mart. 9.19.2
passages.text: Cenantis bene Pontici, Sabelle.

passages.label: Mart. 9.19.3
passages.text: Vis cenare, Sabelle, non lavari.

passages.label: Mart. 9.20.1
passages.text: Haec, quae tota patet tegiturque et marmore et auro,

passages.label: Mart. 9.20.2
passages.text: Infantis domini conscia terra fuit,

passages.label: Mart. 9.20.3
passages.text: Felix o, quantis sonuit vagitibus et quas

passages.label: Mart. 9.20.4
passages.text: Vidit reptantis sustinuitque manus:

passages.label: Mart. 9.20.5
passages.text: Hic steterat veneranda domus, quae praestitit orbi

passages.label: Mart. 9.20.6
passages.text: Quod Rhodos astrifero, quod pia Creta polo.

passages.label: Mart. 9.20.7
passages.text: Curetes texere Iovem crepitantibus armis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.20.8
passages.text: Semiviri poterant qualia ferre Phryges:

passages.label: Mart. 9.20.9
passages.text: At te protexit superu=m pater, et tibi, Caesar,

passages.label: Mart. 9.20.10
passages.text: Pro iaculo et parma fulmen et aegis erat.

passages.label: Mart. 9.21.1
passages.text: Artemidorus habet puerum, sed vendidit agrum;

passages.label: Mart. 9.21.2
passages.text: Agrum pro puero Calliodorus habet.

passages.label: Mart. 9.21.3
passages.text: Dic, uter ex istis melius rem gesserit, Aucte:

passages.label: Mart. 9.21.4
passages.text: Artemidorus amat, Calliodorus arat.

passages.label: Mart. 9.22.1
passages.text: Credis ob haec me, Pastor, opes fortasse rogare,

passages.label: Mart. 9.22.2
passages.text: Propter quae vulgus crassaque turba rogat,

passages.label: Mart. 9.22.3
passages.text: Ut Setina meos consumat glaeba ligones

passages.label: Mart. 9.22.4
passages.text: Et sonet innumera compede Tuscus ager;

passages.label: Mart. 9.22.5
passages.text: Ut Mauri Libycis centum stent dentibus orbes

passages.label: Mart. 9.22.6
passages.text: Et crepet in nostris aurea lamna toris,

passages.label: Mart. 9.22.7
passages.text: Nec labris nisi magna meis crystalla terantur

passages.label: Mart. 9.22.8
passages.text: Et faciant nigras nostra Falerna nives;

passages.label: Mart. 9.22.9
passages.text: Ut canusinatus nostro Syrus assere sudet

passages.label: Mart. 9.22.10
passages.text: Et mea sit culto sella cliente frequens;

passages.label: Mart. 9.22.11
passages.text: Aestuet ut nostro madidus conviva ministro,

passages.label: Mart. 9.22.12
passages.text: Quem permutatum nec Ganymede velis;

passages.label: Mart. 9.22.13
passages.text: Ut lutulenta linat Tyrias mihi mula lacernas

passages.label: Mart. 9.22.14
passages.text: Et Massyla meum virga gubernet equum.

passages.label: Mart. 9.22.15
passages.text: Est nihil ex istis: superos et sidera testor.

passages.label: Mart. 9.22.16
passages.text: Ergo quid? Ut donem, Pastor, et aedificem.

passages.label: Mart. 9.23.1
passages.text: O cui virgineo flavescere contigit auro,

passages.label: Mart. 9.23.2
passages.text: Dic, ubi Palladium sit tibi, Care, decus.

passages.label: Mart. 9.23.3
passages.text: 'Aspicis en domini fulgentes marmore vultus?

passages.label: Mart. 9.23.4
passages.text: Venit ad has ultro nostra corona comas.'

passages.label: Mart. 9.23.5
passages.text: Albanae livere potest pia quercus olivae,

passages.label: Mart. 9.23.6
passages.text: Cinxerit invictum quod prior illa caput.

passages.label: Mart. 9.24.1
passages.text: Quis Palatinos imitatus imagine vultus

passages.label: Mart. 9.24.2
passages.text: Phidiacum Latio marmore vicit ebur?

passages.label: Mart. 9.24.3
passages.text: Haec mundi facies, haec sunt Iovis ora sereni:

passages.label: Mart. 9.24.4
passages.text: Sic tonat ille deus, cum sine nube tonat.

passages.label: Mart. 9.24.5
passages.text: Non solam tribuit Pallas tibi, Care, coronam;

passages.label: Mart. 9.24.6
passages.text: Effigiem domini, quam colis, illa dedit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.25.1
passages.text: Dantem vina tuum quotiens aspeximus Hyllum,

passages.label: Mart. 9.25.2
passages.text: Lumine nos, Afer, turbidiore notas.

passages.label: Mart. 9.25.3
passages.text: Quod, rogo, quod scelus est, mollem spectare ministrum?

passages.label: Mart. 9.25.4
passages.text: Aspicimus solem, sidera, templa, deos.

passages.label: Mart. 9.25.5
passages.text: Avertam vultus, tamquam mihi pocula Gorgon

passages.label: Mart. 9.25.6
passages.text: Porrigat atque oculos oraque nostra petat?

passages.label: Mart. 9.25.7
passages.text: Trux erat Alcides, et Hylan spectare licebat;

passages.label: Mart. 9.25.8
passages.text: Ludere Mercurio cum Ganymede licet.

passages.label: Mart. 9.25.9
passages.text: Si non vis teneros spectet conviva ministros,

passages.label: Mart. 9.25.10
passages.text: Phineas invites, Afer, et Oedipodas.

passages.label: Mart. 9.26.1
passages.text: Audet facundo qui carmina mittere Nervae,

passages.label: Mart. 9.26.2
passages.text: Pallida donabit glaucina, Cosme, tibi,

passages.label: Mart. 9.26.3
passages.text: Paestano violas et cana ligustra colono,

passages.label: Mart. 9.26.4
passages.text: Hyblaeis apibus Corsica mella dabit:

passages.label: Mart. 9.26.5
passages.text: Sed tamen et parvae nonnulla est gratia Musae;

passages.label: Mart. 9.26.6
passages.text: Appetitur posito vilis oliva lupo.

passages.label: Mart. 9.26.7
passages.text: Nec tibi sit mirum, modici quod conscia vatis

passages.label: Mart. 9.26.8
passages.text: Iudicium metuit nostra Thalia tuum:

passages.label: Mart. 9.26.9
passages.text: Ipse tuas etiam veritus Nero dicitur aures,

passages.label: Mart. 9.26.10
passages.text: Lascivum iuvenis cum tibi lusit opus.

passages.label: Mart. 9.27.1
passages.text: Cum depilatos, Chreste, coleos portes

passages.label: Mart. 9.27.2
passages.text: Et vulturino mentulam parem collo

passages.label: Mart. 9.27.3
passages.text: Et prostitutis levius caput culis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.27.4
passages.text: Nec vivat ullus in tuo pilus crure,

passages.label: Mart. 9.27.5
passages.text: Purgentque saevae cana labra volsellae:

passages.label: Mart. 9.27.6
passages.text: Curios, Camillos, Quintios, Numas, Ancos,

passages.label: Mart. 9.27.7
passages.text: Et quidquid umquam legimus pilosorum

passages.label: Mart. 9.27.8
passages.text: Loqueris sonasque grandibus minax verbis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.27.9
passages.text: Et cum theatris saeculoque rixaris.

passages.label: Mart. 9.27.10
passages.text: Occurrit aliquis inter ista si draucus,

passages.label: Mart. 9.27.11
passages.text: Iam paedagogo liberatus et cuius

passages.label: Mart. 9.27.12
passages.text: Refibulavit turgidum faber penem:

passages.label: Mart. 9.27.13
passages.text: Nutu vocatum ducis, et pudet fari

passages.label: Mart. 9.27.14
passages.text: Catoniana, Chreste, quod facis lingua.

passages.label: Mart. 9.28.1
passages.text: Dulce decus scaenae, ludorum fama, Latinus

passages.label: Mart. 9.28.2
passages.text: Ille ego sum, plausus deliciaeque tuae,

passages.label: Mart. 9.28.3
passages.text: Qui spectatorem potui fecisse Catonem,

passages.label: Mart. 9.28.4
passages.text: Solvere qui Curios Fabriciosque graves.

passages.label: Mart. 9.28.5
passages.text: Sed nihil a nostro sumpsit mea vita theatro,

passages.label: Mart. 9.28.6
passages.text: Et sola tantum scaenicus arte feror:

passages.label: Mart. 9.28.7
passages.text: Nec poteram gratus domino sine moribus esse;

passages.label: Mart. 9.28.8

passages.text: Vos me laurigeri parasitum dicite Phoebi,

passages.text: Saecula Nestoreae permensa, Philaeni, senectae,

passages.text: Rapta es ad infernas tam cito Ditis aquas?

passages.label: Mart. 9.29.3
passages.text: Euboicae nondum numerabas longa Sibyllae

passages.label: Mart. 9.29.4
passages.text: Tempora: maior erat mensibus illa tribus.

passages.text: Heu quae lingua silet! non illam mille catastae

passages.text: Vincebant, nec quae turba Sarapin amat,

passages.label: Mart. 9.29.9
passages.text: Quae nunc Thessalico lunam deducere rhombo,

passages.text: Quae sciet hos illos vendere lena toros?

passages.label: Mart. 9.29.11
passages.text: Sit tibi terra levis mollique tegaris harena,

passages.text: Cappadocum saevis Antistius occidit oris

passages.label: Mart. 9.30.2
passages.text: Rusticus. O tristi crimine terra nocens!

passages.label: Mart. 9.30.3
passages.text: Rettulit ossa sinu cari Nigrina mariti

passages.label: Mart. 9.30.4
passages.text: Et questa est longas non satis esse vias;

passages.text: Cumque daret sanctam tumulis, quibus invidet, urnam,

passages.text: Cum comes Arctois haereret Caesaris armis

passages.text: Velius, hanc Marti pro duce vovit avem;

passages.text: Luna quater binos non tota peregerat orbes,

passages.text: Debita poscebat iam sibi vota deus:

passages.text: Ipse suas anser properavit laetus ad aras

passages.label: Mart. 9.31.6
passages.text: Et cecidit sanctis hostia parva focis.

passages.label: Mart. 9.31.7
passages.text: Octo vides patulo pendere nomismata rostro

passages.label: Mart. 9.31.8
passages.text: Alitis? haec extis condita nuper erant:

passages.text: Quae litat argento pro te, non sanguine, Caesar,

passages.text: Hanc volo, quae facilis, quae palliolata vagatur,

passages.text: Hanc volo, quae puero iam dedit ante meo,

passages.text: Hanc volo, quam redimit totam denarius alter,

passages.text: Poscentem nummos et grandia verba sonantem

passages.text: Possideat crassae mentula Burdigalae.

passages.text: Audieris in quo, Flacce, balneo plausum,

passages.text: Maronis illic esse mentulam scito.

passages.text: Iuppiter Idaei risit mendacia busti,

passages.text: Dum videt Augusti Flavia templa poli,

passages.text: Atque inter mensas largo iam nectare fusus,

passages.text: Pocula cum Marti traderet ipse suo,

passages.text: Respiciens Phoebum pariter Phoebique sororem,

passages.text: Cum quibus Alcides et pius Arcas erat:

passages.label: Mart. 9.35.1
passages.text: Artibus his semper cenam, Philomuse, mereris,

passages.label: Mart. 9.35.2
passages.text: Plurima dum fingis, sed quasi vera refers.

passages.label: Mart. 9.35.3
passages.text: Scis, quid in Arsacia Pacorus deliberet aula,

passages.label: Mart. 9.35.4
passages.text: Rhenanam numeras Sarmaticamque manum,

passages.label: Mart. 9.35.5
passages.text: Verba ducis Daci chartis mandata resignas,

passages.label: Mart. 9.35.6
passages.text: Victricem laurum quam venit ante vides,

passages.label: Mart. 9.35.7
passages.text: Scis, quotiens Phario madeat Iove fusca Syene,

passages.label: Mart. 9.35.8
passages.text: Scis, quota de Libyco litore puppis eat,

passages.label: Mart. 9.35.9
passages.text: Cuius Iuleae capiti nascantur olivae,

passages.text: Destinet aetherius cui sua serta pater.

passages.label: Mart. 9.35.11
passages.text: Tolle tuas artes; hodie cenabis apud me

passages.label: Mart. 9.35.12
passages.text: Hac lege, ut narres nil, Philomuse, novi.

passages.label: Mart. 9.36.1
passages.text: Viderat Ausonium posito modo crine ministrum

passages.label: Mart. 9.36.2
passages.text: Phryx puer, alterius gaudia nota Iovis:

passages.label: Mart. 9.36.3
passages.text: 'Quod tuus, ecce, suo Caesar permisit ephebo,

passages.label: Mart. 9.36.4
passages.text: Tu permitte tuo, maxime rector' ait;

passages.label: Mart. 9.36.5
passages.text: 'Iam mihi prima latet longis lanugo capillis,

passages.text: Iam tua me ridet Iuno vocatque virum.'

passages.label: Mart. 9.36.7
passages.text: Cui pater aetherius 'Puer o dulcissime,' dixit,

passages.label: Mart. 9.36.8
passages.text: 'Non ego, quod poscis, res negat ipsa tibi:

passages.label: Mart. 9.36.9
passages.text: Caesar habet noster similis tibi mille ministros

passages.label: Mart. 9.36.10
passages.text: Tantaque sidereos vix capit aula mares;

passages.label: Mart. 9.36.11
passages.text: At tibi si dederit vultus coma tonsa viriles,

passages.label: Mart. 9.36.12
passages.text: Quis mihi, qui nectar misceat, alter erit?'

passages.label: Mart. 9.37.1
passages.text: Cum sis ipsa domi mediaque ornere Subura,

passages.label: Mart. 9.37.2
passages.text: Fiant absentes et tibi, Galla, comae,

passages.label: Mart. 9.37.3
passages.text: Nec dentes aliter quam Serica nocte reponas,

passages.label: Mart. 9.37.4
passages.text: Et iaceas centum condita pyxidibus,

passages.label: Mart. 9.37.5
passages.text: Nec tecum facies tua dormiat, innuis illo,

passages.label: Mart. 9.37.6
passages.text: Quod tibi prolatum est mane, supercilio,

passages.label: Mart. 9.37.7
passages.text: Et te nulla movet cani reverentia cunni,

passages.label: Mart. 9.37.8
passages.text: Quem potes inter avos iam numerare tuos.

passages.label: Mart. 9.37.9
passages.text: Promittis sescenta tamen; sed mentula surda est,

passages.label: Mart. 9.37.10
passages.text: Et sit lusca licet, te tamen illa videt.

passages.label: Mart. 9.38.1
passages.text: Summa licet velox, Agathine, pericula ludas,

passages.label: Mart. 9.38.2
passages.text: Non tamen efficies, ut tibi parma cadat.

passages.label: Mart. 9.38.3
passages.text: Nolentem sequitur, tenuisque reversa per auras

passages.label: Mart. 9.38.4
passages.text: Vel pede vel tergo, crine vel ungue sedet;

passages.label: Mart. 9.38.5
passages.text: Lubrica Corycio quamvis sint pulpita nimbo

passages.label: Mart. 9.38.6
passages.text: Et rapiant celeres vela negata Noti,

passages.label: Mart. 9.38.7
passages.text: Securos pueri neglecta perambulat artus,

passages.label: Mart. 9.38.8
passages.text: Et nocet artifici ventus et unda nihil.

passages.label: Mart. 9.38.9
passages.text: Ut peccare velis, cum feceris omnia, falli

passages.label: Mart. 9.38.10
passages.text: Non potes: arte opus est, ut tibi parma cadat.

passages.label: Mart. 9.39.1
passages.text: Prima Palatino lux est haec orta Tonanti,

passages.label: Mart. 9.39.2
passages.text: Optasset Cybele qua peperisse Iovem;

passages.label: Mart. 9.39.3
passages.text: Hac et sancta mei genita est Caesonia Rufi:

passages.label: Mart. 9.39.4
passages.text: Plus debet matri nulla puella suae.

passages.label: Mart. 9.39.5
passages.text: Laetatur gemina votorum sorte maritus,

passages.label: Mart. 9.39.6
passages.text: Contigit hunc illi quod bis amare diem.

passages.label: Mart. 9.40.1
passages.text: Tarpeias Diodorus ad coronas

passages.label: Mart. 9.40.2
passages.text: Romam cum peteret Pharo relicta,

passages.label: Mart. 9.40.3
passages.text: Vovit pro reditu viri Philaenis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.40.4
passages.text: Illam lingeret ut puella simplex,

passages.label: Mart. 9.40.5
passages.text: Quam castae quoque diligunt Sabinae.

passages.label: Mart. 9.40.6
passages.text: Dispersa rate tristibus procellis

passages.label: Mart. 9.40.7
passages.text: Mersus fluctibus obrutusque ponto

passages.label: Mart. 9.40.8
passages.text: Ad votum Diodorus enatavit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.40.9
passages.text: O tardus nimis et piger maritus!

passages.label: Mart. 9.40.10
passages.text: Hoc in litore si puella votum

passages.label: Mart. 9.40.11
passages.text: Fecisset mea, protinus redissem.

passages.label: Mart. 9.41.1
passages.text: Pontice, quod numquam futuis, sed paelice laeva

passages.label: Mart. 9.41.2
passages.text: Uteris et Veneri servit amica manus,

passages.label: Mart. 9.41.3
passages.text: Hoc nihil esse putas? scelus est, mihi crede, sed ingens,

passages.label: Mart. 9.41.4
passages.text: Quantum vix animo concipis ipse tuo.

passages.label: Mart. 9.41.5
passages.text: Nempe semel futuit, generaret Horatius ut tres,

passages.label: Mart. 9.41.6
passages.text: Mars semel, ut geminos Ilia casta daret:

passages.label: Mart. 9.41.7
passages.text: Omnia perdiderat, si masturbatus uterque

passages.label: Mart. 9.41.8
passages.text: Mandasset manibus gaudia foeda suis.

passages.label: Mart. 9.41.9
passages.text: Ipsam crede tibi naturam dicere rerum:

passages.label: Mart. 9.41.10
passages.text: 'Istud quod digitis, Pontice, perdis, homo est.'

passages.label: Mart. 9.42.1
passages.text: Campis dives Apollo sic Myrinis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.42.2
passages.text: Sic semper senibus fruare cycnis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.42.3
passages.text: Doctae sic tibi serviant sorores,

passages.label: Mart. 9.42.4
passages.text: Nec Delphis tua mentiatur ulli,

passages.label: Mart. 9.42.5
passages.text: Sic Palatia te colant amentque:

passages.label: Mart. 9.42.6
passages.text: Bis senos cito te rogante fasces

passages.label: Mart. 9.42.7
passages.text: Det Stellae bonus adnuatque Caesar.

passages.label: Mart. 9.42.8
passages.text: Felix tunc ego debitorque voti

passages.label: Mart. 9.42.9
passages.text: Casurum tibi rusticas ad aras

passages.label: Mart. 9.42.10
passages.text: Ducam cornibus aureis iuvencum.

passages.label: Mart. 9.42.11
passages.text: Nata est hostia, Phoebe; quid moraris?

passages.label: Mart. 9.43.1
passages.text: Hic qui dura sedens porrecto saxa leone

passages.label: Mart. 9.43.2
passages.text: Mitigat, exiguo magnus in aere deus,

passages.label: Mart. 9.43.3
passages.text: Quaeque tulit, spectat resupino sidera vultu,

passages.label: Mart. 9.43.4
passages.text: Cuius laeva calet robore, dextra mero:

passages.label: Mart. 9.43.5
passages.text: Non est fama recens nec nostri gloria caeli;

passages.label: Mart. 9.43.6
passages.text: Nobile Lysippi munus opusque vides.

passages.label: Mart. 9.43.7
passages.text: Hoc habuit numen Pellaei mensa tyranni,

passages.label: Mart. 9.43.8
passages.text: Qui cito perdomito victor in orbe iacet;

passages.label: Mart. 9.43.9
passages.text: Hunc puer ad Libycas iuraverat Hannibal aras;

passages.label: Mart. 9.43.10
passages.text: Iusserat hic Sullam ponere regna trucem.

passages.label: Mart. 9.43.11
passages.text: Offensus variae tumidis terroribus aulae

passages.label: Mart. 9.43.12
passages.text: Privatos gaudet nunc habitare lares,

passages.label: Mart. 9.43.13
passages.text: Utque fuit quondam placidi conviva Molorchi,

passages.label: Mart. 9.43.14
passages.text: Sic voluit docti Vindicis esse deus.

passages.label: Mart. 9.44.1
passages.text: Alciden modo Vindicis rogabam,

passages.label: Mart. 9.44.2
passages.text: Esset cuius opus laborque felix.

passages.label: Mart. 9.44.3
passages.text: Risit, nam solet hoc, levique nutu

passages.label: Mart. 9.44.4
passages.text: 'Graece numquid' ait 'poeta, nescis?

passages.label: Mart. 9.44.5
passages.text: Inscripta est basis indicatque nomen.'

passages.label: Mart. 9.44.6
passages.text: Λυσίππου lego, Phidiae putavi.

passages.label: Mart. 9.45.1
passages.text: Miles Hyperboreos modo, Marcelline, triones

passages.label: Mart. 9.45.2
passages.text: Et Getici tuleras sidera pigra poli:

passages.text: Ecce Promethei rupes et fabula montis

passages.label: Mart. 9.45.4
passages.text: Quam prope sunt oculis nunc adeunda tuis!

passages.text: Videris inmensis cum conclamata querellis

passages.label: Mart. 9.45.6
passages.text: Saxa senis, dices 'Durior ipse fuit.'

passages.text: Et licet haec addas: 'Potuit qui talia ferre,

passages.text: Humanum merito finxerat ille genus.'

passages.label: Mart. 9.46.1
passages.text: Gellius aedificat semper: modo limina ponit,

passages.label: Mart. 9.46.2
passages.text: Nunc foribus claves aptat emitque seras,

passages.label: Mart. 9.46.3
passages.text: Nunc has, nunc illas reficit mutatque fenestras;

passages.text: Dum tantum aedificet, quidlibet ille facit—

passages.label: Mart. 9.46.5
passages.text: Oranti nummos ut dicere possit amico

passages.label: Mart. 9.46.6
passages.text: Unum illud verbum Gellius 'Aedifico.'

passages.label: Mart. 9.47.1
passages.text: Democritos, Zenonas inexplicitosque Platonas

passages.label: Mart. 9.47.2
passages.text: Quidquid et hirsutis squalet imaginibus,

passages.text: Sic quasi Pythagorae loqueris successor et heres.

passages.label: Mart. 9.47.4
passages.text: Praependet sane nec tibi barba minor:

passages.label: Mart. 9.47.5
passages.text: Sed quod et hircosis serum est et turpe pilosis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.47.6
passages.text: In molli rigidam clune libenter habes.

passages.label: Mart. 9.47.7
passages.text: Tu, qui sectarum causas et pondera nosti,

passages.label: Mart. 9.47.8
passages.text: Dic mihi, percidi, Pannyche, dogma quod est?

passages.label: Mart. 9.48.1
passages.text: Heredem cum me partis tibi, Garrice, quartae

passages.label: Mart. 9.48.2
passages.text: Per tua iurares sacra caputque tuum,

passages.label: Mart. 9.48.3
passages.text: Credidimus,—quis enim damnet sua vota libenter?—

passages.label: Mart. 9.48.4
passages.text: Et spem muneribus fovimus usque datis.

passages.label: Mart. 9.48.5
passages.text: Inter quae rari Laurentem ponderis aprum

passages.label: Mart. 9.48.6
passages.text: Misimus: Aetola de Calydone putes.

passages.label: Mart. 9.48.7
passages.text: At tu continuo populumque patresque vocasti,

passages.label: Mart. 9.48.8
passages.text: Ructat adhuc aprum pallida Roma meum:

passages.label: Mart. 9.48.9
passages.text: Ipse ego,—quis credat?—conviva nec ultimus haesi,

passages.label: Mart. 9.48.10
passages.text: Sed nec costa data est caudave missa mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 9.48.11
passages.text: De quadrante tuo quid sperem, Garrice? Nulla

passages.label: Mart. 9.48.12
passages.text: De nostro nobis uncia venit apro.

passages.label: Mart. 9.49.1
passages.text: Haec est illa meis multum cantata libellis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.49.2
passages.text: Quam meus edidicit lector amatque togam.

passages.label: Mart. 9.49.3
passages.text: Partheniana fuit quondam, memorabile vatis

passages.label: Mart. 9.49.4
passages.text: Munus: in hac ibam conspiciendus eques,

passages.label: Mart. 9.49.5
passages.text: Dum nova, dum nitida fulgebat splendida lana,

passages.label: Mart. 9.49.6
passages.text: Dumque erat auctoris nomine digna sui:

passages.label: Mart. 9.49.7
passages.text: Nunc anus et tremulo vix accipienda tribuli,

passages.label: Mart. 9.49.8
passages.text: Quam possis niveam dicere iure tuo.

passages.label: Mart. 9.49.9
passages.text: Quid non longa dies, quid non consumitis anni?

passages.label: Mart. 9.49.10
passages.text: Haec toga iam non est Partheniana, mea est.

passages.label: Mart. 9.50.1
passages.text: Ingenium mihi, Gaure, probas sic esse pusillum,

passages.label: Mart. 9.50.2
passages.text: Carmina quod faciam, quae brevitate placent.

passages.label: Mart. 9.50.3
passages.text: Confiteor. Sed tu bis senis grandia libris

passages.label: Mart. 9.50.4
passages.text: Qui scribis Priami proelia, magnus homo es?

passages.label: Mart. 9.50.5
passages.text: Nos facimus Bruti puerum, nos Langona vivum:

passages.label: Mart. 9.50.6
passages.text: Tu magnus luteum, Gaure, Giganta facis.

passages.label: Mart. 9.51.1
passages.text: Quod semper superos invito fratre rogasti,

passages.label: Mart. 9.51.2
passages.text: Hoc, Lucane, tibi contigit, ante mori.

passages.label: Mart. 9.51.3
passages.text: Invidet ille tibi; Stygias nam Tullus ad umbras

passages.label: Mart. 9.51.4
passages.text: Optabat, quamvis sit minor, ire prior.

passages.text: Tu colis Elysios nemorisque habitator amoeni

passages.text: Esse tuo primum nunc sine fratre cupis;

passages.text: Et si iam nitidis alternus venit ab astris,

passages.text: Si credis mihi, Quinte, quod mereris,

passages.text: Natales, Ovidi, tuas Aprilis

passages.label: Mart. 9.52.3

passages.text: Felix utraque lux diesque nobis

passages.label: Mart. 9.52.5
passages.text: Signandi melioribus lapillis!

passages.text: Hic vitam tribuit, sed hic amicum.

passages.text: Natali tibi, Quinte, tuo dare parva volebam

passages.text: Munera; tu prohibes: inperiosus homo es.

passages.text: Parendum est monitis, fiat quod uterque volemus

passages.text: Aut crescente levis traheretur harundine praeda

passages.text: Nec frater nobis nec prior esset avus.

passages.text: Nunc sturnos inopes fringuillarumque querellas

passages.text: Audit et arguto passere vernat ager;

passages.text: Hinc prope summa rapax miluus astra volat.

passages.label: Mart. 9.54.11
passages.text: Mittimus ergo tibi parvae munuscula chortis:

passages.text: Qualia si recipis, saepe propinquus eris.

passages.label: Mart. 9.55.1
passages.text: Luce propinquorum, qua plurima mittitur ales,

passages.label: Mart. 9.55.2
passages.text: Dum Stellae turdos, dum tibi, Flacce, paro,

passages.label: Mart. 9.55.3
passages.text: Succurrit nobis ingens onerosaque turba,

passages.label: Mart. 9.55.4
passages.text: In qua se primum quisque meumque putat.

passages.label: Mart. 9.55.5
passages.text: Demeruisse duos votum est; offendere plures

passages.label: Mart. 9.55.6
passages.text: Vix tutum; multis mittere dona grave est.

passages.label: Mart. 9.55.7
passages.text: Qua possum sola veniam ratione merebor:

passages.label: Mart. 9.55.8
passages.text: Nec Stellae turdos nec tibi, Flacce, dabo.

passages.label: Mart. 9.56.1
passages.text: Spendophoros Libycas domini petit armiger urbis:

passages.label: Mart. 9.56.2
passages.text: Quae puero dones tela, Cupido, para,

passages.label: Mart. 9.56.3
passages.text: Illa quibus iuvenes figis mollesque puellas:

passages.label: Mart. 9.56.4
passages.text: Sit tamen in tenera levis et hasta manu.

passages.label: Mart. 9.56.5
passages.text: Loricam clipeumque tibi galeamque remitto;

passages.label: Mart. 9.56.6
passages.text: Tutus ut invadat proelia, nudus eat:

passages.label: Mart. 9.56.7
passages.text: Non iaculo, non ense fuit laesusve sagitta,

passages.label: Mart. 9.56.8
passages.text: Casside dum liber Parthenopaeus erat.

passages.label: Mart. 9.56.9
passages.text: Quisquis ab hoc fuerit fixus, morietur amore.

passages.label: Mart. 9.56.10
passages.text: O felix, si quem tam bona fata manent!

passages.label: Mart. 9.56.11
passages.text: Dum puer es, redeas, dum vultu lubricus, et te

passages.label: Mart. 9.56.12
passages.text: Non Libye faciat, sed tua Roma virum.

passages.label: Mart. 9.57.1
passages.text: Nil est tritius Hedyli lacernis:

passages.label: Mart. 9.57.2
passages.text: Non ansae veterum Corinthiorum,

passages.label: Mart. 9.57.3
passages.text: Nec crus compede lubricum decenni,

passages.label: Mart. 9.57.4
passages.text: Nec ruptae recutita colla mulae,

passages.label: Mart. 9.57.5
passages.text: Nec quae Flaminiam secant salebrae,

passages.label: Mart. 9.57.6
passages.text: Nec qui litoribus nitent lapilli,

passages.label: Mart. 9.57.7
passages.text: Nec Tusca ligo vinea politus,

passages.label: Mart. 9.57.8
passages.text: Nec pallens toga mortui tribulis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.57.9
passages.text: Nec pigri rota quassa mulionis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.57.10
passages.text: Nec rasum cavea latus visontis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.57.11
passages.text: Nec dens iam senior ferocis apri.

passages.label: Mart. 9.57.12
passages.text: Res una est tamen: ipse non negabit,

passages.label: Mart. 9.57.13
passages.text: Culus tritior Hedyli lacernis.

passages.label: Mart. 9.58.1
passages.text: Nympha sacri regina lacus, cui grata Sabinus

passages.label: Mart. 9.58.2
passages.text: Et mansura pio munere templa dedit,

passages.label: Mart. 9.58.3
passages.text: Sic montana tuos semper colat Umbria fontes,

passages.label: Mart. 9.58.4
passages.text: Nec tua Baianas Sassina malit aquas:

passages.label: Mart. 9.58.5
passages.text: Excipe sollicitos placide, mea dona, libellos;

passages.label: Mart. 9.58.6
passages.text: Tu fueris Musis Pegasis unda meis.—

passages.label: Mart. 9.58.7
passages.text: 'Nympharum templis quisquis sua carmina donat,

passages.label: Mart. 9.58.8
passages.text: Quid fieri libris debeat, ipse monet.'

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.1
passages.text: In Saeptis Mamurra diu multumque vagatus,

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.2
passages.text: Hic ubi Roma suas aurea vexat opes,

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.3
passages.text: Inspexit molles pueros oculisque comedit,

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.4
passages.text: Non hos, quos primae prostituere casae,

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.5
passages.text: Sed quos arcanae servant tabulata catastae

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.6
passages.text: Et quos non populus nec mea turba videt.

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.7
passages.text: Inde satur mensas et opertos exuit orbes

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.8
passages.text: Expositumque alte pingue poposcit ebur,

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.9
passages.text: Et testudineum mensus quater hexaclinon

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.10
passages.text: Ingemuit citro non satis esse suo.

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.11
passages.text: Consuluit nares, an olerent aera Corinthon,

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.12
passages.text: Culpavit statuas et, Polyclite, tuas,

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.13
passages.text: Et turbata brevi questus crystallina vitro

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.14
passages.text: Murrina signavit seposuitque decem

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.15
passages.text: Expendit veteres calathos et si qua fuerunt

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.16
passages.text: Pocula Mentorea nobilitata manu,

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.17
passages.text: Et viridis picto gemmas numeravit in auro,

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.18
passages.text: Quidquid et a nivea grandius aure sonat.

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.19
passages.text: Sardonychas vero mensa quaesivit in omni

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.20
passages.text: Et pretium magnis fecit iaspidibus.

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.21
passages.text: Undecima lassus cum iam discederet hora,

passages.label: Mart. 9.59.22
passages.text: Asse duos calices emit et ipse tulit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.60.1
passages.text: Seu tu Paestanis genita es seu Tiburis arvis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.60.2
passages.text: Seu rubuit tellus Tuscula flore tuo,

passages.label: Mart. 9.60.3
passages.text: Seu Praenestino te vilica legit in horto,

passages.label: Mart. 9.60.4
passages.text: Seu modo Campani gloria ruris eras:

passages.label: Mart. 9.60.5
passages.text: Pulchrior ut nostro videare corona Sabino,

passages.label: Mart. 9.60.6
passages.text: De Nomentano te putet esse meo.

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.1
passages.text: In Tartesiacis domus est notissima terris,

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.2
passages.text: Qua dives placidum Corduba Baetin amat,

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.3
passages.text: Vellera nativo pallent ubi flava metallo

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.4
passages.text: Et linit Hesperium brattea viva pecus.

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.5
passages.text: Aedibus in mediis totos amplexa penates

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.6
passages.text: Stat platanus densis Caesariana comis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.7
passages.text: Hospitis invicti posuit quam dextera felix,

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.8
passages.text: Coepit et ex illa crescere virga manu.

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.9
passages.text: Auctorem dominumque nemus sentire videtur:

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.10
passages.text: Sic viret et ramis sidera celsa petit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.11
passages.text: Saepe sub hac madidi luserunt arbore Fauni,

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.12
passages.text: Terruit et tacitam fistula sera domum;

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.13
passages.text: Dumque fugit solos nocturnum Pana per agros,

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.14
passages.text: Saepe sub hac latuit rustica fronde Dryas.

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.15
passages.text: Atque oluere lares comissatore Lyaeo,

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.16
passages.text: Crevit et effuso laetior umbra mero;

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.17
passages.text: Hesternisque rubens deiecta est herba coronis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.18
passages.text: Atque suas potuit dicere nemo rosas.

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.19
passages.text: O dilecta deis, o magni Caesaris arbor,

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.20
passages.text: Ne metuas ferrum sacrilegosque focos.

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.21
passages.text: Perpetuos sperare licet tibi frondis honores:

passages.label: Mart. 9.61.22
passages.text: Non Pompeianae te posuere manus.

passages.label: Mart. 9.62.1
passages.text: Tinctis murice vestibus quod omni

passages.label: Mart. 9.62.2
passages.text: Et nocte utitur et die Philaenis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.62.3
passages.text: Non est ambitiosa nec superba:

passages.label: Mart. 9.62.4
passages.text: Delectatur odore, non colore.

passages.label: Mart. 9.63.1
passages.text: Ad cenam invitant omnes te, Phoebe, cinaedi.

passages.label: Mart. 9.63.2
passages.text: Mentula quem pascit, non, puto, purus homo est.

passages.label: Mart. 9.64.1
passages.text: Herculis in magni voltus descendere Caesar

passages.label: Mart. 9.64.2
passages.text: Dignatus Latiae dat nova templa viae,

passages.label: Mart. 9.64.3
passages.text: Qua, Triviae nemorosa petit dum regna, viator

passages.label: Mart. 9.64.4
passages.text: Octavum domina marmor ab urbe legit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.64.5
passages.text: Ante colebatur votis et sanguine largo,

passages.label: Mart. 9.64.6
passages.text: Maiorem Alciden nunc minor ipse colit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.64.7
passages.text: Hunc magnas rogat alter opes, rogat alter honores;

passages.label: Mart. 9.64.8
passages.text: Illi securus vota minora facit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.65.1
passages.text: Alcide, Latio nunc agnoscende Tonanti,

passages.label: Mart. 9.65.2
passages.text: Postquam pulchra dei Caesaris ora geris,

passages.label: Mart. 9.65.3
passages.text: Si tibi tunc isti vultus habitusque fuissent,

passages.label: Mart. 9.65.4
passages.text: Cesserunt manibus cum fera monstra tuis:

passages.label: Mart. 9.65.5
passages.text: Argolico famulum non te servire tyranno

passages.label: Mart. 9.65.6
passages.text: Vidissent gentes saevaque regna pati,

passages.label: Mart. 9.65.7
passages.text: Sed tu iussisses Eurysthea; nec tibi fallax

passages.label: Mart. 9.65.8
passages.text: Portasset Nessi perfida dona Lichas,

passages.label: Mart. 9.65.9
passages.text: Oetaei sine lege rogi securus adisses

passages.label: Mart. 9.65.10
passages.text: Astra patris summi, quae tibi poena dedit;

passages.label: Mart. 9.65.11
passages.text: Lydia nec dominae traxisses pensa superbae,

passages.label: Mart. 9.65.12
passages.text: Nec Styga vidisses Tartareumque canem.

passages.label: Mart. 9.65.13
passages.text: Nunc tibi Iuno favet, nunc te tua diligit Hebe;

passages.label: Mart. 9.65.14
passages.text: Nunc te si videat nympha, remittet Hylan.

passages.label: Mart. 9.66.1
passages.text: Uxor cum tibi sit formosa, pudica, puella,

passages.label: Mart. 9.66.2
passages.text: Quo tibi natorum iura, Fabulle, trium?

passages.label: Mart. 9.66.3
passages.text: Quod petis a nostro supplex dominoque deoque,

passages.label: Mart. 9.66.4
passages.text: Tu dabis ipse tibi, si potes arrigere.

passages.label: Mart. 9.67.1
passages.text: Lascivam tota possedi nocte puellam,

passages.label: Mart. 9.67.2
passages.text: Cuius nequitias vincere nemo potest.

passages.label: Mart. 9.67.3
passages.text: Fessus mille modis illud puerile poposci:

passages.label: Mart. 9.67.4
passages.text: Ante preces totas primaque verba dedit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.67.5
passages.text: Inprobius quiddam ridensque rubensque rogavi:

passages.label: Mart. 9.67.6
passages.text: Pollicitast nulla luxuriosa mora.

passages.label: Mart. 9.67.7
passages.text: Sed mihi pura fuit; tibi non erit, Aeschyle, si vis

passages.label: Mart. 9.67.8
passages.text: Accipere hoc munus condicione mala.

passages.label: Mart. 9.68.1
passages.text: Quid tibi nobiscum est, ludi scelerate magister,

passages.label: Mart. 9.68.2
passages.text: Invisum pueris virginibusque caput?

passages.label: Mart. 9.68.3
passages.text: Nondum cristati rupere silentia galli:

passages.label: Mart. 9.68.4
passages.text: Murmure iam saevo verberibusque tonas.

passages.label: Mart. 9.68.5
passages.text: Tam grave percussis incudibus aera resultant,

passages.label: Mart. 9.68.6
passages.text: Causidicum medio cum faber aptat equo;

passages.label: Mart. 9.68.7
passages.text: Mitior in magno clamor furit amphitheatro,

passages.label: Mart. 9.68.8
passages.text: Vincenti parmae cum sua turba favet.

passages.label: Mart. 9.68.9
passages.text: Vicini somnum—non tota nocte—rogamus:

passages.label: Mart. 9.68.10
passages.text: Nam vigilare leve est, pervigilare grave est.

passages.label: Mart. 9.68.11
passages.text: Discipulos dimitte tuos. Vis, garrule, quantum

passages.label: Mart. 9.68.12
passages.text: Accipis ut clames, accipere ut taceas?

passages.label: Mart. 9.69.1
passages.text: Cum futuis, Polycharme, soles in fine cacare.

passages.label: Mart. 9.69.2
passages.text: Cum pedicaris, quid, Polycharme, facis?

passages.label: Mart. 9.70.1
passages.text: Dixerat 'o mores! o tempora!' Tullius olim,

passages.label: Mart. 9.70.2
passages.text: Sacrilegum strueret cum Catilina nefas,

passages.label: Mart. 9.70.3
passages.text: Cum gener atque socer diris concurreret armis

passages.label: Mart. 9.70.4
passages.text: Maestaque civili caede maderet humus.

passages.label: Mart. 9.70.5
passages.text: Cur nunc 'o mores!', cur nunc 'o tempora!' dicis?

passages.label: Mart. 9.70.6
passages.text: Quod tibi non placeat, Caeciliane, quid est?

passages.label: Mart. 9.70.7
passages.text: Nulla ducum feritas, nulla est insania ferri;

passages.label: Mart. 9.70.8
passages.text: Pace frui certa laetitiaque licet.

passages.label: Mart. 9.70.9
passages.text: Non nostri faciunt, tibi quod tua tempora sordent,

passages.label: Mart. 9.70.10
passages.text: Sed faciunt mores, Caeciliane, tui.

passages.label: Mart. 9.71.1
passages.text: Massyli leo fama iugi pecorisque maritus

passages.label: Mart. 9.71.2
passages.text: Lanigeri mirum qua coiere fide.

passages.label: Mart. 9.71.3
passages.text: Ipse licet videas, cavea stabulantur in una

passages.label: Mart. 9.71.4
passages.text: Et pariter socias carpit uterque dapes:

passages.label: Mart. 9.71.5
passages.text: Nec fetu nemorum gaudent nec mitibus herbis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.71.6
passages.text: Concordem satiat sed rudis agna famem.

passages.label: Mart. 9.71.7
passages.text: Quid meruit terror Nemees, quid portitor Helles,

passages.label: Mart. 9.71.8
passages.text: Ut niteant celsi lucida signa poli?

passages.label: Mart. 9.71.9
passages.text: Sidera si possent pecudesque feraeque mereri,

passages.label: Mart. 9.71.10
passages.text: Hic aries astris, hic leo dignus erat.

passages.label: Mart. 9.72.1
passages.text: Liber, Amyclaea frontem vittate corona,

passages.label: Mart. 9.72.2
passages.text: Qui quatis Ausonia verbera Graia manu,

passages.label: Mart. 9.72.3
passages.text: Clusa mihi texto cum prandia vimine mittas,

passages.label: Mart. 9.72.4
passages.text: Cur comitata dapes nulla lagona venit?

passages.label: Mart. 9.72.5
passages.text: Atqui digna tuo si nomine munera ferres,

passages.label: Mart. 9.72.6
passages.text: Scis, puto, debuerint quae mihi dona dari.

passages.label: Mart. 9.73.1
passages.text: Dentibus antiquas solitus producere pelles

passages.label: Mart. 9.73.2
passages.text: Et mordere luto putre vetusque solum,

passages.label: Mart. 9.73.3
passages.text: Praenestina tenes decepti regna patroni,

passages.label: Mart. 9.73.4
passages.text: In quibus indignor si tibi cella fuit;

passages.label: Mart. 9.73.5
passages.text: Rumpis et ardenti madidus crystalla Falerno,

passages.label: Mart. 9.73.6
passages.text: Et pruris domini cum Ganymede tui.

passages.label: Mart. 9.73.7
passages.text: At me litterulas stulti docuere parentes:

passages.label: Mart. 9.73.8
passages.text: Quid cum grammaticis rhetoribusque mihi?

passages.label: Mart. 9.73.9
passages.text: Frange leves calamos et scinde, Thalia, libellos,

passages.label: Mart. 9.73.10
passages.text: Si dare sutori calceus ista potest.

passages.label: Mart. 9.74.1
passages.text: Effigiem tantum pueri pictura Camoni

passages.label: Mart. 9.74.2
passages.text: Servat, et infantis parva figura manet.

passages.label: Mart. 9.74.3
passages.text: Florentes nulla signavit imagine voltus,

passages.label: Mart. 9.74.4
passages.text: Dum timet ora pius muta videre pater.

passages.label: Mart. 9.75.1
passages.text: Non silice duro structilive caemento,

passages.label: Mart. 9.75.2
passages.text: Nec latere cocto, quo Samiramis longam

passages.label: Mart. 9.75.3
passages.text: Babylona cinxit, Tucca balneum fecit:

passages.label: Mart. 9.75.4
passages.text: Sed strage nemorum pineaque conpage,

passages.label: Mart. 9.75.5
passages.text: Ut navigare Tucca balneo possit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.75.6
passages.text: Idem beatas lautus extruit thermas

passages.label: Mart. 9.75.7
passages.text: De marmore omni, quod Carystos invenit,

passages.label: Mart. 9.75.8
passages.text: Quod Phrygia Synnas, Afra quod Nomas misit,

passages.label: Mart. 9.75.9
passages.text: Et quod virenti fonte lavit Eurotas.

passages.label: Mart. 9.75.10
passages.text: Sed ligna desunt: subice balneum thermis.

passages.label: Mart. 9.76.1
passages.text: Haec sunt illa mei quae cernitis ora Camoni,

passages.label: Mart. 9.76.2
passages.text: Haec pueri facies primaque forma fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.76.3
passages.text: Creverat hic vultus bis denis fortior annis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.76.4
passages.text: Gaudebatque suas pingere barba genas,

passages.label: Mart. 9.76.5
passages.text: Et libata semel summos modo purpura cultros

passages.label: Mart. 9.76.6
passages.text: Sparserat: invidit de tribus una soror

passages.label: Mart. 9.76.7
passages.text: Et festinatis incidit stamina pensis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.76.8
passages.text: Absentemque patri rettulit urna rogum.

passages.label: Mart. 9.76.9
passages.text: Sed ne sola tamen puerum pictura loquatur,

passages.label: Mart. 9.76.10
passages.text: Haec erit in chartis maior imago meis.

passages.label: Mart. 9.77.1
passages.text: Quod optimum sit disputat convivium

passages.label: Mart. 9.77.2
passages.text: Facunda Prisci pagina,

passages.label: Mart. 9.77.3
passages.text: Et multa dulci, multa sublimi refert,

passages.label: Mart. 9.77.4
passages.text: Sed cuncta docto pectore.

passages.label: Mart. 9.77.5
passages.text: Quod optimum sit quaeritis convivium?

passages.label: Mart. 9.77.6
passages.text: In quo choraules non erit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.78.1
passages.text: Funera post septem nupsit tibi Galla virorum,

passages.label: Mart. 9.78.2
passages.text: Picentine: sequi vult, puto, Galla viros.

passages.label: Mart. 9.79.1
passages.text: Oderat ante ducum famulos turbamque priorem

passages.label: Mart. 9.79.2
passages.text: Et Palatinum Roma supercilium:

passages.label: Mart. 9.79.3
passages.text: At nunc tantus amor cunctis, Auguste, tuorum est,

passages.label: Mart. 9.79.4
passages.text: Ut sit cuique suae cura secunda domus.

passages.label: Mart. 9.79.5
passages.text: Tam placidae mentes, tanta est reverentia nostri,

passages.label: Mart. 9.79.6
passages.text: Tam pacata quies, tantus in ore pudor.

passages.label: Mart. 9.79.7
passages.text: Nemo suos—haec est aulae natura potentis—,

passages.label: Mart. 9.79.8
passages.text: Sed domini mores Caesarianus habet.

passages.label: Mart. 9.80.1
passages.text: Duxerat esuriens locupletem pauper anumque:

passages.label: Mart. 9.80.2
passages.text: Uxorem pascit Gellius et futuit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.81.1
passages.text: Lector et auditor nostros probat, Aule, libellos,

passages.label: Mart. 9.81.2
passages.text: Sed quidam exactos esse poeta negat.

passages.label: Mart. 9.81.3
passages.text: Non nimium curo: nam cenae fercula nostrae

passages.label: Mart. 9.81.4
passages.text: Malim convivis quam placuisse cocis.

passages.label: Mart. 9.82.1
passages.text: Dixerat astrologus periturum te cito, Munna,

passages.label: Mart. 9.82.2
passages.text: Nec, puto, mentitus dixerat ille tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 9.82.3
passages.text: Nam tu dum metuis, ne quid post fata relinquas,

passages.label: Mart. 9.82.4
passages.text: Hausisti patrias luxuriosus opes,

passages.label: Mart. 9.82.5
passages.text: Bisque tuum deciens non toto tabuit anno:

passages.label: Mart. 9.82.6
passages.text: Dic mihi, non hoc est, Munna, perire cito?

passages.label: Mart. 9.83.1
passages.text: Inter tanta tuae miracula, Caesar, harenae,

passages.label: Mart. 9.83.2
passages.text: Quae vincit veterum munera clara ducum,

passages.label: Mart. 9.83.3
passages.text: Multum oculi, sed plus aures debere fatentur

passages.label: Mart. 9.83.4
passages.text: Se tibi, quod spectant qui recitare solent.

passages.label: Mart. 9.84.1
passages.text: Cum tua sacrilegos contra, Norbane, furores

passages.label: Mart. 9.84.2
passages.text: Staret pro domino Caesare sancta fides,

passages.label: Mart. 9.84.3
passages.text: Haec ego Pieria ludebam tutus in umbra,

passages.label: Mart. 9.84.4
passages.text: Ille tuae cultor notus amicitiae.

passages.label: Mart. 9.84.5
passages.text: Me tibi Vindelicis Raetus narrabat in oris,

passages.label: Mart. 9.84.6
passages.text: Nescia nec nostri nominis Arctos erat:

passages.label: Mart. 9.84.7
passages.text: O quotiens veterem non infitiatus amicum

passages.label: Mart. 9.84.8
passages.text: Dixisti 'Meus est iste poeta, meus!'

passages.label: Mart. 9.84.9
passages.text: Omne tibi nostrum quod bis trieteride iuncta

passages.label: Mart. 9.84.10
passages.text: Ante dabat lector, nunc dabit auctor opus.

passages.label: Mart. 9.85.1
passages.text: Languidior noster si quando est Paulus, Atili,

passages.label: Mart. 9.85.2
passages.text: Non se, convivas abstinet ille suos.

passages.label: Mart. 9.85.3
passages.text: Tu languore quidem subito fictoque laboras,

passages.label: Mart. 9.85.4
passages.text: Sed mea porrexit sportula, Paule, pedes.

passages.label: Mart. 9.86.1
passages.text: Festinata sui gemeret quod fata Severi

passages.label: Mart. 9.86.2
passages.text: Silius, Ausonio non semel ore potens,

passages.label: Mart. 9.86.3
passages.text: Cum grege Pierio maestus Phoeboque querebar.

passages.label: Mart. 9.86.4
passages.text: 'Ipse meum flevi' dixit Apollo 'Linon:'

passages.label: Mart. 9.86.5
passages.text: Respexitque suam quae stabat proxima fratri

passages.label: Mart. 9.86.6
passages.text: Calliopen et ait: 'Tu quoque vulnus habes.

passages.label: Mart. 9.86.7
passages.text: Aspice Tarpeium Palatinumque Tonantem:

passages.label: Mart. 9.86.8
passages.text: Ausa nefas Lachesis laesit utrumque Iovem.

passages.label: Mart. 9.86.9
passages.text: Numina cum videas duris obnoxia fatis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.86.10
passages.text: Invidia possis exonerare deos.'

passages.label: Mart. 9.87.1
passages.text: Septem post calices Opimiani

passages.label: Mart. 9.87.2
passages.text: Denso cum iaceam triente blaesus,

passages.label: Mart. 9.87.3
passages.text: Affers nescio quas mihi tabellas

passages.label: Mart. 9.87.4
passages.text: Et dicis 'Modo liberum esse iussi

passages.label: Mart. 9.87.5
passages.text: Nastam—servolus est mihi paternus—:

passages.label: Mart. 9.87.6
passages.text: Signa.' Cras melius, Luperce, fiet:

passages.label: Mart. 9.87.7
passages.text: Nunc signat meus anulus lagonam.

passages.label: Mart. 9.88.1
passages.text: Cum me captares, mittebas munera nobis:

passages.label: Mart. 9.88.2
passages.text: Postquam cepisti, das mihi, Rufe, nihil.

passages.label: Mart. 9.88.3
passages.text: Ut captum teneas, capto quoque munera mitte,

passages.label: Mart. 9.88.4
passages.text: De cavea fugiat ne male pastus aper.

passages.label: Mart. 9.89.1
passages.text: Lege nimis dura convivam scribere versus

passages.label: Mart. 9.89.2
passages.text: Cogis, Stella. 'Licet scribere nempe malos.'

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.1
passages.text: Sic in gramine florido reclinis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.2
passages.text: Qua gemmantibus hinc et inde rivis

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.3
passages.text: Curva calculus excitatur unda,

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.4
passages.text: Exclusis procul omnibus molestis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.5
passages.text: Pertundas glaciem triente nigro,

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.6
passages.text: Frontem sutilibus ruber coronis;

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.7
passages.text: Sic uni tibi sit puer cinaedus

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.8
passages.text: Et castissima pruriat puella:

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.9
passages.text: Infamem nimio calore Cypron

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.10
passages.text: Observes, moneo precorque, Flacce,

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.11
passages.text: Messes area cum teret crepantis

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.12
passages.text: Et fervens iuba saeviet leonis.

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.13
passages.text: At tu, diva Paphi, remitte, nostris

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.14
passages.text: Inlaesum iuvenem remitte votis:

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.15
passages.text: Sic Martis tibi serviant Kalendae

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.16
passages.text: Et cum ture meroque victimaque

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.17
passages.text: Libetur tibi candidas ad aras

passages.label: Mart. 9.90.18
passages.text: Secta plurima quadra de placenta.

passages.label: Mart. 9.91.1
passages.text: Ad cenam si me diversa vocaret in astra

passages.label: Mart. 9.91.2
passages.text: Hinc invitator Caesaris, inde Iovis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.91.3
passages.text: Astra licet propius, Palatia longius essent,

passages.label: Mart. 9.91.4
passages.text: Responsa ad superos haec referenda darem:

passages.label: Mart. 9.91.5
passages.text: 'Quaerite qui malit fieri conviva Tonantis:

passages.label: Mart. 9.91.6
passages.text: Me meus in terris Iuppiter, ecce, tenet.'

passages.label: Mart. 9.92.1
passages.text: Quae mala sint domini, quae servi commoda, nescis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.92.2
passages.text: Condyle, qui servum te gemis esse diu.

passages.label: Mart. 9.92.3
passages.text: Dat tibi securos vilis tegeticula somnos,

passages.label: Mart. 9.92.4
passages.text: Pervigil in pluma Gaius, ecce, iacet.

passages.label: Mart. 9.92.5
passages.text: Gaius a prima tremebundus luce salutat

passages.label: Mart. 9.92.6
passages.text: Tot dominos, at tu, Condyle, nec dominum.

passages.label: Mart. 9.92.7
passages.text: 'Quod debes, Gai, redde' inquit Phoebus et illinc

passages.label: Mart. 9.92.8
passages.text: Cinnamus: hoc dicit, Condyle, nemo tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 9.92.9
passages.text: Tortorem metuis? podagra cheragraque secatur

passages.label: Mart. 9.92.10
passages.text: Gaius et mallet verbera mille pati.

passages.label: Mart. 9.92.11
passages.text: Quod nec mane vomis nec cunnum, Condyle, lingis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.92.12
passages.text: Non mavis, quam ter Gaius esse tuus?

passages.label: Mart. 9.93.1
passages.text: Addere quid cessas, puer, inmortale Falernum?

passages.label: Mart. 9.93.2
passages.text: Quadrantem duplica de seniore cado.

passages.label: Mart. 9.93.3
passages.text: Nunc mihi dic, quis erit, cui te, Catacisse, deorum

passages.label: Mart. 9.93.4
passages.text: Sex iubeo cyathos fundere? 'Caesar erit.'

passages.label: Mart. 9.93.5
passages.text: Sutilis aptetur deciens rosa crinibus, ut sit

passages.label: Mart. 9.93.6
passages.text: Qui posuit sacrae nobile gentis opus.

passages.label: Mart. 9.93.7
passages.text: Nunc bis quina mihi da basia, fiat ut illud

passages.label: Mart. 9.93.8
passages.text: Nomen, ab Odrysio quod deus orbe tulit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.94.1
passages.text: Santonica medicata dedit mihi pocula virga:

passages.label: Mart. 9.94.2
passages.text: Os hominis! mulsum me rogat Hippocrates.

passages.label: Mart. 9.94.3
passages.text: Tam stupidus numquam nec tu, puto, Glauce, fuisti,

passages.label: Mart. 9.94.4
passages.text: χάλκεα donanti χρύσεα qui dederas.

passages.label: Mart. 9.94.5
passages.text: Dulce aliquis munus pro munere poscit amaro?

passages.label: Mart. 9.94.6
passages.text: Accipiat, sed si potat in elleboro.

passages.label: Mart. 9.95.1
passages.text: Alfius ante fuit, coepit nunc Olfius esse,

passages.label: Mart. 9.95.2
passages.text: Uxorem postquam duxit Athenagoras.

passages.label: Mart. 9.95b.3
passages.text: Nomen Athenagorae credis, Callistrate, verum.

passages.label: Mart. 9.95b.4
passages.text: Si scio, dispeream, qui sit Athenagoras.

passages.label: Mart. 9.95b.5
passages.text: Sed puta me verum, Callistrate, dicere nomen:

passages.label: Mart. 9.95b.6
passages.text: Non ego, sed vester peccat Athenagoras.

passages.label: Mart. 9.96.1
passages.text: Clinicus Herodes trullam subduxerat aegro:

passages.label: Mart. 9.96.2
passages.text: Deprensus dixit 'Stulte, quid ergo bibis?'

passages.label: Mart. 9.97.1
passages.text: Rumpitur invidia quidam, carissime Iuli,

passages.label: Mart. 9.97.2
passages.text: Quod me Roma legit, rumpitur invidia.

passages.label: Mart. 9.97.3
passages.text: Rumpitur invidia, quod turba semper in omni

passages.label: Mart. 9.97.4
passages.text: Monstramur digito, rumpitur invidia.

passages.label: Mart. 9.97.5
passages.text: Rumpitur invidia, tribuit quod Caesar uterque

passages.label: Mart. 9.97.6
passages.text: Ius mihi natorum, rumpitur invidia.

passages.label: Mart. 9.97.7
passages.text: Rumpitur invidia, quod rus mihi dulce sub urbe est

passages.label: Mart. 9.97.8
passages.text: Parvaque in urbe domus, rumpitur invidia.

passages.label: Mart. 9.97.9
passages.text: Rumpitur invidia, quod sum iucundus amicis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.97.10
passages.text: Quod conviva frequens, rumpitur invidia.

passages.label: Mart. 9.97.11
passages.text: Rumpitur invidia, quod amamur quodque probamur:

passages.label: Mart. 9.97.12
passages.text: Rumpatur, quisquis rumpitur invidia.

passages.label: Mart. 9.98.1
passages.text: Vindemiarum non ubique proventus

passages.label: Mart. 9.98.2
passages.text: Cessavit, Ovidi; pluvia profuit grandis.

passages.label: Mart. 9.98.3
passages.text: Centum Coranus amphoras aquae fecit.

passages.label: Mart. 9.99.1
passages.text: Marcus amat nostras Antonius, Attice, Musas,

passages.label: Mart. 9.99.2
passages.text: Charta salutatrix si modo vera refert:

passages.label: Mart. 9.99.3
passages.text: Marcus Palladiae non infitianda Tolosae

passages.label: Mart. 9.99.4
passages.text: Gloria, quem genuit Pacis alumna Quies.

passages.label: Mart. 9.99.5
passages.text: Tu qui longa potes dispendia ferre viarum,

passages.label: Mart. 9.99.6
passages.text: I, liber, absentis pignus amicitiae.

passages.label: Mart. 9.99.7
passages.text: Vilis eras, fateor, si te nunc mitteret emptor;

passages.label: Mart. 9.99.8
passages.text: Grande tui pretium muneris auctor erit:

passages.label: Mart. 9.99.9
passages.text: Multum, crede mihi, refert, a fonte bibatur

passages.label: Mart. 9.99.10
passages.text: Quae fluit, an pigro quae stupet unda lacu.

passages.label: Mart. 9.100.1
passages.text: Denaris tribus invitas et mane togatum

passages.label: Mart. 9.100.2
passages.text: Observare iubes atria, Basse, tua,

passages.label: Mart. 9.100.3
passages.text: Deinde haerere tuo lateri, praecedere sellam,

passages.label: Mart. 9.100.4
passages.text: Ad viduas tecum plus minus ire decem.

passages.label: Mart. 9.100.5
passages.text: Trita quidem nobis togula est vilisque vetusque:

passages.label: Mart. 9.100.6
passages.text: Denaris tamen hanc non emo, Basse, tribus.

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.1
passages.text: Appia, quam simili venerandus in Hercule Caesar

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.2
passages.text: Consecrat, Ausoniae maxima fama viae,

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.3
passages.text: Si cupis Alcidae cognoscere facta prioris,

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.4
passages.text: Disce: Libyn domuit, aurea poma tulit,

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.5
passages.text: Peltatam Scythico discinxit Amazona nodo,

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.6
passages.text: Addidit Arcadio terga leonis apro,

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.7
passages.text: Aeripedem silvis cervum, Stymphalidas astris

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.8
passages.text: Abstulit, a Stygia cum cane venit aqua,

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.9
passages.text: Fecundam vetuit reparari mortibus hydram,

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.10
passages.text: Hesperias Tusco lavit in amne boves.

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.11
passages.text: Haec minor Alcides: maior quae gesserit, audi,

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.12
passages.text: Sextus ab Albana quem colit arce lapis.

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.13
passages.text: Adseruit possessa malis Palatia regnis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.14
passages.text: Prima suo gessit pro Iove bella puer;

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.15
passages.text: Solus Iuleas cum iam retineret habenas,

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.16
passages.text: Tradidit inque suo tertius orbe fuit;

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.17
passages.text: Cornua Sarmatici ter perfida contudit Histri,

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.18
passages.text: Sudantem Getica ter nive lavit equum;

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.19
passages.text: Saepe recusatos parcus duxisse triumphos

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.20
passages.text: Victor Hyperboreo nomen ab orbe tulit;

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.21
passages.text: Templa deis, mores populis dedit, otia ferro,

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.22
passages.text: Astra suis, caelo sidera, serta Iovi.

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.23
passages.text: Herculeum tantis numen non sufficit actis:

passages.label: Mart. 9.101.24
passages.text: Tarpeio deus hic commodet ora patri.

passages.label: Mart. 9.102.1
passages.text: Quadringentorum reddis mihi, Phoebe, tabellas:

passages.label: Mart. 9.102.2
passages.text: Centum da potius mutua, Phoebe, mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 9.102.3
passages.text: Quaere alium, cui te tam vano munere iactes:

passages.label: Mart. 9.102.4
passages.text: Quod tibi non possum solvere, Phoebe, meum est.

passages.label: Mart. 9.103.1
passages.text: Quae nova tam similes genuit tibi Leda ministros?

passages.label: Mart. 9.103.2
passages.text: Quae capta est alio nuda Lacaena cycno?

passages.label: Mart. 9.103.3
passages.text: Dat faciem Pollux Hiero, dat Castor Asylo,

passages.label: Mart. 9.103.4
passages.text: Atque in utroque nitet Tyndaris ore soror.

passages.label: Mart. 9.103.5
passages.text: Ista Therapnaeis si forma fuisset Amyclis,

passages.label: Mart. 9.103.6
passages.text: Cum vicere duas dona minora deas,

passages.label: Mart. 9.103.7
passages.text: Mansisses, Helene, Phrygiamque redisset in Iden

passages.label: Mart. 9.103.8
passages.text: Dardanius gemino cum Ganymede Paris.
